zone: PK-2 Status Sync (transitions, recall, undo, concurrency)

findings.title: OrderStateMachine FROZEN, forward-only whitelist enforced — integrity OK
findings.evidence: allows() switch enumerates per-from-state targets. KDS-relevant transitions: ACCEPT->PREPARING (line 45 — only PREPARING+CANCELED allowed from ACCEPT for non-POS); PREPARING->PREPARED (line 52). PREPARED can only go OUT_FOR_DELIVERY|DELIVERED (line 55) — no PREPARED->PREPARING reverse transition. CANCELED/REJECTED/RETURNED are terminal except Admin override (line 64-70).
findings.impact: State machine cannot regress to a prior status from KDS — by design. Any 'recall' from PREPARED back to PREPARING would have to either (a) be added to the state machine (FROZEN, requires owner gate), or (b) live entirely client-side (current implementation, see PK-2-ARCH-04).

findings.title: KDS controller hardcodes whitelist {ACCEPT, PREPARING, PREPARED} via dedicated FormRequest
findings.evidence: kdsStatuses() returns exactly [ACCEPT(4), PREPARING(7), PREPARED(8)]. Rule::in(self::kdsStatuses()) applied to BOTH status and expected_status. A KDS request to cancel/return/reject (forbidden per CV1-M07-KDS-RELEASE) is rejected at validation layer BEFORE reaching the service.
findings.impact: Double defense: Form Request whitelist + service-layer KitchenReleaseRule::canTransition() at KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService:209. Even if FormRequest was bypassed (no observed bypass path), the service would reject illegal transitions.

findings.title: Two-layer transition guard inside KDS service
findings.evidence: `KitchenReleaseRule::canTransition($from, $to)` (forward-only ACCEPT->PREPARING->PREPARED) AND `OrderStateMachine::allows($from, $to, $user)` (full whitelist) both gate the mutation. Either failing throws 422 invalid_status_transition.

findings.title: Spec drift — `recall` is client-side localStorage only, not a backend transition (matches brief but worth declaring)
findings.evidence: Vuex `kds/recallItem` removes a bump marker from in-memory + localStorage. There is NO backend POST. Window: `Date.now() - b[itemId] >= 60000` (line 71) — 60s. i18n strings agree: 'kds_recall_grace_expired' says 'délai d'annulation (60 s) dépassé' (resources/js/languages/fr.json:1189).
findings.drift: Task brief says 'recall: bump back from PREPARED -> PREPARING (5s window)'. The implementation is: (a) per-item localStorage marker with 60s grace, (b) order-level pre-PATCH cancellation via KdsV2Grid undo toast with 3s window. NEITHER reverses a persisted backend status.
findings.impact: If owner expectation is 'KDS can un-mark Prêt on the chef screen with the order showing as PREPARING again everywhere (POS, OSS, KDS)' — current implementation does NOT satisfy that. The chef's localStorage marker won't survive a page refresh on another KDS tablet or another station. The 3s V2 undo cancels BEFORE the PATCH, so server never sees PREPARED.
findings.recommendation: EITHER (a) declare current scope-limited undo/recall as final V1 design and align brief, OR (b) escalate to owner-gate to allow PREPARED->PREPARING in OrderStateMachine (frozen-zone change, requires LOCK doc). Recommend (a) — current design is conservative and matches modern KDS UX (Toast/Otter all require explicit action on a forward-only ticket lifecycle).

findings.title: Window-time drift between client-side undo paths (3s V2 vs 60s legacy per-item)
findings.evidence: KdsV2Grid onCtaTap schedules a setTimeout(..., 3000) before emitting change-status. KdsUndoToast hard-codes the same 3000ms. Meanwhile, the per-item kds.recallItem grace is 60000ms.
findings.impact: Visual mismatch and confusion: two simultaneously-mounted UIs offer wildly different 'undo' affordances. The V2 grid is the V1 default (kds.v2_enabled flag, public/js/admin-kds.js compiled). The 60s per-item path is the LEGACY 4-column code path retained for rollback.
findings.recommendation: Document in CLAUDE.md / KDS doc that V1 production = V2 grid = 3s pre-PATCH undo. The 60s localStorage recall is dead-code-by-default. Consider a follow-up to either delete or harmonize at V1.0.2.

findings.title: Bidirectional sync architecture: POS->KDS via OrderStatusChanged broadcast; KDS->POS via same path
findings.evidence: POS side: OrderService::changeStatus (line 1864) calls `\App\Events\OrderStatusChanged::dispatch($order, $oldStatusForBroadcast, $targetStatus)` after commit. KDS side: KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService:242 calls `kdsTicketDispatcher->dispatch($snapshot, $oldStatus, $newStatus)` which gates on KitchenReleaseRule::shouldDispatchStatusChanged (KDS-internal transitions only) then dispatches OrderStatusChanged. Both POS and KDS subscribe to OrderStatusChanged on private-branch.{branch_id} (Vue: PosComponent.vue:2169, KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1789).
findings.verdict: PASS — bidirectional sync wiring is symmetric

findings.title: Outbox persistence via PersistOrderStatusChangedToOutbox correctly scoped per correlation_id
findings.evidence: Idempotency key = sha1(EventType|order_id|old|new|correlation_id). Same (old,new) tuple in different correlation_id (e.g. legitimate Admin DELIVERED<->RETURNED revert) gets a fresh row; duplicate listener fire within same request collapses (firstOrCreate).
findings.verdict: PASS — iter14 SPECIALIST-2 design comment matches behavior

findings.title: Auto-transition watcher in KdsV2Grid bypasses 3s undo window
findings.evidence: When no order is PREPARING and a NEW order at the head exists, watcher emits 'auto-promote' which directly fires onV2ChangeStatus -> PATCH. No toast. No 3s grace.
findings.impact: Chef intent unclear — but auto-promote is documented design (kdsAutoTransition.js comment: 'deliberate departure for FoodKing V1 single-chef takeaway-only'). Server safety relies on OrderStateMachine::apply lockForUpdate idempotent early-return, which is correct. Low risk under current single-chef V1 assumption; medium risk if a second station ships.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2 — gate auto-promote behind a per-branch settings toggle so multi-station deployments can disable it without code change.

attestations: OrderStateMachine.php — read-only, NOT modified by this audit (frozen zone respected)
All KDS transition entry points double-guard via OrderStateMachine::allows + KitchenReleaseRule::canTransition
OrderStatusChanged broadcast is the single bidirectional sync channel between POS and KDS — coherent design
